transcript.text: Alright, before we settle anything, I want to do my usual routine. Everyone here, please state any practical terms, constraints, or alternatives you know about — anything that might affect how we work this out. That way we're all on the same page before I make a decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact barter proposal is this: I repair the kitchen faucet and replace its supply connection on Sunday, in exchange for one kiln firing of up to 24 pieces, with no cash changing hands.
transcript.speaker: A2
transcript.raw_output: {"type":"reveal","fact_id":"PF1","text":"My exact barter proposal is this: I repair the kitchen faucet and replace its supply connection on Sunday, in exchange for one kiln firing of up to 24 pieces, with no cash changing hands."}

transcript.text: My exact alternative is to do the same kitchen work for $160 cash on Saturday.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I inspected Theo's clay, and it's low-fire clay that must be fired at cone 06, not the kiln's usual cone 6 setting. Whoever fires it needs to know that, or the pieces could be ruined.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I inspected the plumbing connection, and the replacement must use a 3/8-inch braided supply line with a compression fitting. Whoever does the work needs to know that spec.

Theo's pottery must be fired at cone 06, not the kiln's usual cone 6 setting, as the clay is low-fire.
Rafael's alternative offer of $160 cash on Saturday is acknowledged but not accepted.
